status: mixed cache-ablation results; no default change based on this cohort
comparison_direction: Reference elapsed / W7-default elapsed. Above one favors the default optimization; below one favors disabling it.

cpu_affinity.reason: Hybrid CPU and observed unrelated background load. Pin single-thread API samples to the same performance core; retain normal priority. Multi-thread samples use all logical processors. User processes are not modified.

timing.contract: Rotated independent-process variant order; workload order reverses on alternate process rounds. First calls excluded from mean/median summaries, retained in raw rows. All accepted baseline output hashes enforced on every result. Unique removes byte-identical payload duplicates before API, so its speedup cannot be due to batch duplicate sharing. No input/filesystem cold-cache claim. Process peak working set includes loading, verification and retained results; not heap payload. Optional prewarm runs are archived separately and were declared before the cohort. Instrumented timing is diagnostic only and must not be used as performance evidence.

quality.reason: Concurrent unrelated builds; this run verifies pinned source output hashes only.
quality.rounds_reason: Driver requires 1..=50, so rounds=0 is rejected.

ordinary.summary: Arithmetic means primary for requested average; medians and nearest-rank p95 retained; first calls archived separately, no discarded measured samples.

ablations.summary: Each of three rotated variants appears once in each position per workload; workload order reverses on odd rounds without reversing variants.

constraints: No owned builds, tests, scans or source edits during a complete timing cohort.
No source/quality/diagnostic duration is a performance sample.
PGO and Worker timings have separate matched-control protocols.
Do not multiply speed ratios from separate cohorts.

limitations: All owned builds, tests, scans and source edits were idle during the full timing window.
Three rotated process rounds balance all three variant positions; six repeated corpus samples and 60 UI samples are retained. First calls are separate, prewarm excluded.
The inline ablation disables only the exact-order dirty-block scheduler; it does not disable the complete SSA fact cache.
The temp ablation returns to the legacy temporary usage census. Each flag is measured separately; no combined-disabled variant is measured.
Mixed one/16-thread and mean/median results do not justify a universal cache benefit or a thread-dependent runtime policy.
Small sample count, whole-process RSS and nearest-rank p95 limitations remain. No samples were discarded.
